findings.title: En passant square set unconditionally
findings.detail: nextEnPassant sets enPassant after every double push even with no adjacent enemy pawn (follows plan Decision 11). Legality is unaffected because pawnTargets re-validates the victim pawn. Before adding threefold repetition, either set it only when a capture is possible or normalize it when comparing positions.

findings.title: Promotion choice is the caller's job
findings.detail: getLegalMoves returns Coord[], so the four promotion moves must be expanded by the client/gameManager (prompt for N/B/R/Q); otherwise the move defaults to queen. By design; note for the client work.

findings.title: getGameState overwrites END
findings.detail: The state is derived only from the position and never returns END, so recomputing it on a resigned game loses END. gameManager should keep END rather than call getGameState again on a finished game.
